knowledge.name: Fixed synthetic BOM and master data
knowledge.detail: Three fictional projects, eight BOM lines and six items with specs, prices, attestations and data sheets.

knowledge.name: Synthetic vendor certificates and answers
knowledge.detail: Five fictional vendors with certificate dates, questionnaire answers and certificate letters ground each finding.

knowledge.name: Alternates catalog and drafting rules
knowledge.detail: Same-spec alternates, cost-impact rule and the approved-step drafts the agent may prepare.

intelligence_processing.name: Weekly BOM change scan
intelligence_processing.detail: Scans every approved bill of materials each week and reports what is new or changed.

intelligence_processing.name: Materials compliance check
intelligence_processing.detail: Flags items that newly fall out of the materials sourcing rule, with the reason and cited evidence.

intelligence_processing.name: Compliant alternates
intelligence_processing.detail: Finds compliant alternates with the same specification and sizes the cost of switching.

intelligence_processing.name: Vendor certificate watch
intelligence_processing.detail: Watches vendor certificates and questionnaire answers so lapses are caught before the next order.

intelligence_processing.name: Audit evidence readiness
intelligence_processing.detail: Keeps the audit evidence package ready by project, with every open item tied to its record.

intelligence_processing.name: Approved next-step drafts
intelligence_processing.detail: Prepares hold notices, renewal, substitution and document requests for a person to send after approval.

clients_user_interface.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio conversation
clients_user_interface.detail: Hosts the Draft agent with six skills and two synthetic knowledge files; publish stays a separate approved step.

clients_user_interface.name: Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot access
clients_user_interface.detail: Gives procurement and compliance staff a conversational entry point once approved controls are configured.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file MaterialsComplianceAgent locally with deterministic, synthetic-only routing.

management_reporting.name: Weekly change and compliance view
management_reporting.detail: Shows new and changed BOM lines and each non-compliant, conflicting or incomplete item with its evidence.

management_reporting.name: Vendor certificate watch list
management_reporting.detail: Lists expired and expiring vendor certificates with the covered items they affect.

management_reporting.name: Audit evidence readiness by project
management_reporting.detail: Counts complete covered lines per project and names every open item before review.

tools.name: Portable MaterialsComplianceAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent with six deterministic, read-only operations over bundled synthetic data.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the agent and exposes chat, health and tool-routing endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the six-skill package in Draft; explicit authorized approval is required before publication.

tools.name: SharePoint
tools.detail: Cited production seam for certificates, attestations and evidence; the package uses fixed synthetic files instead.

tools.name: Microsoft Word
tools.detail: Cited production seam for hold notices and vendor requests; the package returns draft text only.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Uses only bundled fictional BOM, master data and vendor records; never browses or invents a certificate.

supporting_features.name: Cited-evidence findings
supporting_features.detail: Every non-compliant, conflict or gap finding names the record it depends on.

supporting_features.name: Recommend-first approval gate
supporting_features.detail: Drafts are prepared only for next steps a person approved and are never sent by the agent.

supporting_features.name: No external side effects
supporting_features.detail: Never orders, changes master data, sends a request or certifies compliance.

supporting_features.name: Deterministic routing and validation
supporting_features.detail: Six persona cases verify one bounded operation each with exact evidence anchors.
